overview: A compact, human-readable representation of a deterministic linear model.
usage:
# Model Format

JSON with intercept and slope fields.

# Training Data

Deterministic synthetic regression rows.

# Model Inputs

A numeric x value.

# Model Outputs

Prediction = intercept + slope * x.

# Model Usage

Load model.json and apply the documented equation.

# Fine-tuning

Not applicable.

# Changelog

Version 1: initial audited coefficients.
